headline: Dark Magician Deck
title: Dark Magician Deck Guide | Best Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links Decks November 2026
video_script: This is the Dark Magician deck in Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links, a Tier 2 deck on Duel Links Meta this week. The Skill is The Eye of the United Dragon. With fifteen or more Dark Magician cards in your Deck: once per Duel, play Timaeus the United Dragon from your hand and add two Dark Magician cards from your Deck, and once per Duel, play Dark Magician or Dark Magician Girl from your Deck face-down and add The Eye of Timaeus from outside your Deck. The key cards: Dark Magician, two thousand five hundred attack, the heart of the deck. Timaeus the United Dragon Special Summons itself by sending a Spellcaster or a Dark Magician Spell or Trap, and then Fusion Summons using a Spellcaster. Illusion of Chaos searches Dark Magician from your Deck, and on your opponent's turn it brings Dark Magician back from the Graveyard and negates a monster effect. Dark Magical Curtain Special Summons a DARK Spellcaster from your hand or Deck, and with Dark Magician it adds a Dark Magician Spell or Trap. And Dark Magician the Dragon Knight, three thousand attack, which keeps your Spells and Traps safe from your opponent's targeting and destruction. How does it play? Dark Magician comes out early, Timaeus turns it into big Fusions, and Lava Golem plus The Winged Dragon of Ra Sphere Mode deal with monsters the deck cannot beat in battle. This list is a top deck from the nineteenth of November, with 30 cards in the Main Deck. Which deck should I cover next? Comment below!
